remarks: Located in South Wilton, this Cape Cod charmer is sure to impress. This 4 bedroom 2 bath home has an updated kitchen with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, breakfast bar and center island. The spacious dining room has plenty of room for family gatherings or playing your favorite board games around the table. Step down into the large living room with fireplace, built-in book shelves, vaulted ceiling with skylights and large picture window offering plenty of natural light. Plus sliding glass doors to the private backyard. Additional features of the home include an office, primary bedroom with decorative fireplace, hardwood floors, security system, public water and city sewer!! This home is situated on .65 acres of flat, parklike property with beautiful gardens, patio, fence, shed and stone walls. The Clover Drive neighborhood is a private enclave, perfect for walking and biking. Minutes away from both Westport and Wilton town centers, award winning schools, train and major highways.Convenient living at it's best! Book your appointment.
